channel.title: Hashbeam
channel.description: Hashbeam reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network security, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and market structure across blockchains and tokens.

item.title: Wallet Extension Conflicts: Open the Right Wallet in One Browser
item.description: Fix multiple wallet extensions conflicting in a browser by choosing a wallet by name, setting its default, or isolating wallets in separate profiles.

item.title: DeFi vault performance fees and net yield
item.description: A performance fee in a DeFi vault takes a share of interest earned, not principal. Convert gross APY to net yield, then account for any management fee.

item.title: How to bridge Bitcoin to Polygon: Receive teleBTC
item.description: To bridge Bitcoin to Polygon, deposit BTC through TeleSwap and receive teleBTC at a Polygon address after verification; swap separately if you want another token.

item.title: Why Base funds don't appear in Coinbase after a bridge
item.description: Why don't my Base funds show in my Coinbase account? The bridge sends them to your wallet on Base; send them to Coinbase’s Base deposit address to credit your balance.

item.title: How to Add Base to MetaMask Before You Bridge
item.description: How to add Base network to MetaMask: choose Base from the network list, use Chainlist, or enter verified mainnet details before bridging and confirm your address.

item.title: EU proposes crypto network sanctions in 22nd Russia package
item.description: The Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions package would widen bank transaction bans and target crypto and payment networks, but still needs unanimous approval.

item.title: EU targets crypto networks in proposed Russia sanctions
item.description: The Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions package would target crypto and payment networks, including third-country enablers, alongside new bank and sports restrictions.

item.title: EU’s 22nd Russia sanctions proposal targets crypto networks
item.description: The Commission proposed targeting crypto and payment networks in its 22nd Russia sanctions package, alongside measures affecting banks, sports and energy.

item.title: How to trace a cross-chain transfer that delivered the wrong token
item.description: Which block explorer to check when a cross chain transfer looks wrong: verify what left on the source chain, then find the token and amount delivered on the destination.

item.title: Choose a swap mode by what the trade must fix
item.description: Exact input vs exact output swap difference comes down to which side is fixed: spend a set amount and protect minimum output, or target output and cap maximum input.

item.title: Transaction hashes and bridge transfer IDs across chains
item.description: What is the difference between a transaction hash and a bridge transfer ID? A hash identifies one on-chain transaction; a transfer ID tracks steps across chains.

item.title: Ledger With TronLink vs Software Wallet: Choose Your TRON Setup
item.description: Ledger with TronLink vs software wallet for TRON DEX trading: use Ledger for larger balances and software-only TronLink for frequent, smaller swaps.

item.title: Intent Bridges vs Canonical Bridges for Large Transfers
item.description: Intent based bridge vs canonical bridge: intents can move common tokens faster, while canonical routes suit large or uncommon transfers without solver liquidity.

item.title: How Does a Flashbots Relay Work? Follow a Wallet Swap
item.description: How does a Flashbots relay work? A signed swap travels from a private wallet endpoint through configured hints to builders, but inclusion waits for a proposed block.

item.title: LayerZero DVNs verify messages before delivery
item.description: What is a DVN in LayerZero? It verifies a source-chain message hash on the destination before an executor delivers it, using app-selected verifier requirements.

item.title: US Seeks Forfeiture of $1.1B in Binance-Hack USDC
item.description: The Justice Department has filed to forfeit more than $1.1 billion in USDC tied to Binance’s October hack, advancing frozen assets into a court process.

item.title: Weekly dapp approvals: cap them, then review
item.description: Should you revoke approvals for dapps you use every week? Usually keep them capped: limit token exposure while avoiding repeated approval and revocation fees.

item.title: EU proposal targets crypto networks in 22nd Russia sanctions package
item.description: The European Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions proposal would extend transaction bans to 60 banks and target crypto networks, but leaves the crypto measures’ scope unspecified.

item.title: Berachain bridge only from Ethereum? Routes for beginners
item.description: The Berachain bridge does not only work from Ethereum: routes into Berachain can also begin on Arbitrum and Base. Cross-chain messaging and relayer…

item.title: Large token swap: routing versus manual chunks
item.description: Split a large token swap into smaller trades or do one? Usually, one routed swap gives the better net fill; split over time only when impact stays high and gas is cheap.
